{{Quote|You are reading this because you have been chosen as a Rally Master, charged with training recruits, preparing Watchers for operations and commanding them in battle. Like Cassus Fett's Rally Masters of ancient times, you must educate and inspire our warriors, so they understand their heritage and will sacrifice their lives for it.|[[Tor Vizsla]]|<ref name="TBHC" />}}
'''''Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad''''' was a [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] manifesto and training guide supposedly [[Author/Legends|written]] by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter-group's [[Secret Mandalore|founder]], [[Tor Vizsla]]. The manifesto contained an account of Mandalorian history, Death Watch's founding, goals, and training, and several illustrations depicting numerous topics Vizsla considered to be of interest. ''Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad'' was intended for Death Watch [[Rally Master]]s, in order to help them train and guide new recruits.<ref name="TBHC" />

Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Tor Vizsla at the [[Limb/Legends|hands]] of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Fett acquired a copy of ''Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad''. Over time, Fett personally annotated and passed on his copy of the Death Watch manifesto to his son, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba]]. In one of his notes, Fett doubted its authenticity and suggested that [[Dred Priest]], [[Isabet Reau]], or [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] wrote the manifesto.<ref name="TBHC" />

Years later, Boba Fett later bound the Death Watch manifesto—complete with notations of his own—with a copy of the [[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]] to form a compendium he labeled "[[The Bounty Hunter Code]]," a [[Book/Legends|tome]] he intended to pass on to his own daughter, [[Ailyn Vel]]. Fett never had the chance, however,<ref name="TBHC" /> as a series of tragic events led to his [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|estrangement]] from [[Clan Fett|his family]].

After temporarily [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|falling]] into the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> [[Officer/Legends|officers]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] took possession of "The Bounty Hunter Code" from Fett's [[Starship/Legends|ship]], [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']],<ref name="TBHC" /> before he could later free himself.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad'' was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe as part of the [[2013]] bounty hunter reference guide ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', co-[[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Jason Fry]], and [[Ryder Windham]].<ref name="TBHC" />
